capabilities: identify source notes in configured folders as color groups
propagate source colors to linked notes via BFS over incoming and outgoing links
render split-color nodes for notes linked to multiple sources
read existing graph color groups from native graph settings
rebuild the color cache with a refresh command
extras: README states the plugin is read-only and never modifies Obsidian's native graph.json configuration; source folder colors can also be set via native graph color group queries and will be respected.
intentEvidence: dynamically colors graph nodes based on their linked "source" notes
problem: Obsidian's graph color groups only assign colors by path filters, so notes cannot inherit colors from the source notes they link to.
summary: Graph view plugin that colors nodes by their linked source notes, propagating colors through links with split-color nodes for multi-source notes.
